Moonemans, S. Ram, R. N. Spaans, K. Szolnoky, N. Vincent, H. Akebli, T. F. Coelho, J. J. Twilt, A. Saha, H. Grönberg, K. Kartasalo, G. Litjens, M. Eklund, on behalf of the CHIMERA consortium\ninstitutions: karolinska, radboud_university_medical_center\n\npublication_details: Grand Challenge\npublication_link: https://chimera-agent.grand-challenge.org/chimera-agent/\n---\n\n# CHIMERA-Agent Challenge: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning for Prostate Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis\n\n## Abstract\n\n### Background and objective\n\nCHIMERA-Agent extends the CHIMERA benchmark toward agentic multimodal reasoning across the prostate cancer patient journey. Rather than assuming clean, complete, single-modality data, the challenge reflects real-world urological practice across three clinical tasks: an MRI-only decision on biopsy necessity, post-biopsy risk stratification into one of four EAU/NCCN-aligned management strategies, and post-prostatectomy biochemical recurrence prediction. Submissions must provide structured reasoning traces showing how the available multimodal evidence was interpreted and integrated, with unsupported or hallucinated findings penalized; organizers supply pretrained, modality-specific tools (MRI segmentation, automated Gleason grading, csPCa detection) rather than requiring participants to train models from scratch.\n";
